title: Two reflections and exact ranks for level-four double polylogarithms
coordinate_convention: D_(a,b)(x,y)=sum_(n>m>=1) x^n y^m/(n^a m^b); X^(a-1) Y^(b-1)
row_model: Finite imaginary shuffle and stuffle rows; when exactly one factor is Li_1(1), only the stuffle-minus-shuffle cancellation row; no distribution or higher-depth rows.

trust_boundaries: Uniform proofs are ordinary mathematics, not proof-assistant checked.
Exact finite certificates are independently regenerable with the bundled code.
Numerical comparisons use floating point without outward rounding and are diagnostics only.
The S4 evaluation and numerical period independence remain unproved here.
The known general parity principle is not claimed as a new theorem.
